messages:
kevin: Heads-up — we've started getting a bunch of `inference-queue-depth` alerts for prod-west since ~08:10. Looks noise-y, not sure if it's real backlog or an instrumentation blip. anyone digging?

sre-bot: [ALERT] inference-queue-depth (prod-west) fired 18 times in last 10m. p99 queue length = 42. https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/inf-queue/1941239876 :alarm_clock:

maria: I'm seeing the same in the dashboard. p95 usually ~6, jumped to ~30 after the A/B routing rollout. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/prod-west/queue-depth

olga: Could be the new canary routing sending small fanout batches to a single shard. I can pull router logs — give me 5.

jamal: Noticed an increase in short-lived requests (higher QPS but much smaller token counts). Might be affecting batching heuristics and making the queue appear longer while throughput is fine.

kevin: Good call. Any immediate mitigation suggestions? Thinking a short mute window for the alert while we verify, and maybe tweak the alert threshold to use sustained >30 for 5m instead of instant spikes.

maria: +1 on a short mute. We should avoid paging on transient routing changes. I can open a 30m suppress window if we agree. Also adding `avg over 2m` to that rule would reduce churn.

olga: I pulled logs — router shows increased `route=exp-b` traffic pinned to shard-3. snippet:```json
{"ts":"2026-03-17T08:11:02Z","route":"exp-b","shard":"shard-3","queue_len":38}
{"ts":"2026-03-17T08:11:12Z","route":"exp-b","shard":"shard-3","queue_len":41}```

jamal: If it's traffic skew, scaling shard capacity or redistributing routes would help long-term. For now mute + adjust alert aggregation seems fine.

oncall-bot: Pager duty policy: `eng-sre` escalation will be suppressed for next 30m for alert inference-queue-depth in prod-west if approved by channel lead.

kevin: Approved. maria — please create the 30m suppress and post the mute id. Also can you change the rule suggestion in PR form? I can review later.

maria: Created suppress id `suppress-1941239876-1` (30m). Applied to `prod-west` for `inference-queue-depth`. Link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/suppresses/suppress-1941239876-1

maria: Draft PR for alert tuning: change to `avg(queue_len[2m]) > 30 for 5m` and add an annotation linking to runbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/4282

olga: Thanks. I'm also going to add a quick dashboard panel showing per-route queue length so we don't have to dig logs next time.

kevin: Quick checklist: 1) suppress up (done), 2) PR open (done), 3) follow-up to rebalance exp-b route or update router placement (olga + infra), 4) postmortem if this recurs after tuning.

jamal: FYI I ran `kubectl get hpa -n inference` — shard-3 HPA is healthy but scaling is limited by pod startup due to image pull throttling; raising to the infra team as part of TODO.

maria: Adding runbook pointer to PR and to the suppress note: https://intranet.redwood.ai/runbooks/queue-backpressure

kevin: Perfect. I'll monitor for any other alerts. If anything starts paging again, re-open. :thumbsup:

olga: posted the per-route panel draft: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/prod-west/per-route-queue (will iterate)

sre-bot: Alert suppressed (suppress-1941239876-1) by maria at 2026-03-17T08:17:30Z.

kevin: Thanks everyone — closing the noisy signal for now. We'll follow the PR and infra action items.

jamal: leaving a note in #incidents for traceability: https://incidents.redwood.ai/1941239876

maria: will merge the PR after one more review, and schedule a follow-up sync with infra next week.

kevin: cool. if anyone sees regressions ping here or page as usual.
